title: TodayReminderRequest
description: today.reminder-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/reminders and POST /api/v1/reminders/parse on OpenVibe.Today (today.reminder.write; the acting person). The reminder is plain words, parsed by Today into a rule in the person's time zone ("stretch every 2 hours from 9 to 5", "take my meds every day at 9 am and 9 pm", "pay rent on the 1st of every month"). POST /api/v1/reminders/:id/snooze takes { minutes } alone.

text.description: What to remind the person of, and when, in their own words.

tz.description: The person's IANA time zone (America/Chicago); an unknown zone is read as UTC.

url.description: Where the reminder came from: an https link kept on it and opened from the notification. Anything else is dropped.

source.description: The site that set it (vibe, live, work…), shown to the person.

minutes.description: Snooze only: how long, from now.
